desc: Paper notes: a note left from one address is taken back from another (a phone between networks): the device's code (notes_code.txt, a test code put in the user folder) is its author, not the address (TTYD_NOTES_PAGE, TTYD_NOTES_TEST, TTYD_NOTES_TEST_MOVE: no relay, the test answers with the relay's rules and changes the address after each note left). Two notes left on the page, the address changing after each, then the first taken back from the third address: taken, forgotten in notes.txt; the code itself is never in the log
log_must: ^\[notes\] test: take gor_00 t1: Your note is taken back\.$
